I'm so sorry you're carrying this much pain. What you're describing—physical and emotional abuse, betrayal, being blamed and torn down—is not something you caused, and it's not something you deserve. The way he treats you is not a reflection of your worth. You sound like someone who gives a lot, and it hurts deeply to have that met with cruelty.

Please know your safety matters most. Physical abuse can escalate, and you don't have to face this alone. If you're in the US, you can reach the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-7233 (or text START to 88788) any time, confidentially—they can help you think through your options and safety, without pressure. If you're ever in immediate danger, call emergency services.

You mentioned crying most days and feeling unsure and alone—those feelings make sense given what you're living through. Is there a trusted friend or family member you could lean on right now? You deserve support and to feel safe.
